newsitem.title: USA: Dignity Partners sets 1.0 mln shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Dignity Partners sets 1.0 mln shr buyback.

text.p: Dignity Partners Inc said Friday its board of directors approved the repurchase of up to 1.0 million shares of its common stock.
The company had about 4.2 million shares outstanding in August.
Dignity said it thought the current price of its common stock was undervalued. The stock was trading recently at 2-3/4, down from a 52-week high of 14-1/2.

The company said in a statement it thought the market had overreacted to announcements made since July, when it said it suspended processing of applications for viatical settlements for people with AIDS or the HIV virus.
A viatical settlement is the payment of cash in return for an ownership interest in, and the right to receive the death benefit from, a life insurance policy.
